truths.CP2:
WITH delivered AS (
  -- one row per delivered order: the person who placed it and the day it was placed
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
         CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS order_day
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
firsts AS (
  -- one row per person: the day of the first delivered order
  SELECT customer_unique_id, MIN(order_day) AS first_day
  FROM delivered
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS people
FROM firsts
WHERE first_day >= DATE '2017-01-01'
  AND first_day < DATE '2018-01-01'
truths.CP4:
WITH delivered AS (
  -- one row per delivered order: the person who placed it and the day it was placed
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
         CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS order_day
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
firsts AS (
  -- one row per person: the day of the first delivered order
  SELECT customer_unique_id, MIN(order_day) AS first_day
  FROM delivered
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
people AS (
  -- one row per person whose first delivered order was placed in 2017, with 1 when the person came back
  SELECT f.customer_unique_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN d.order_day > f.first_day AND d.order_day <= DATE '2018-08-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS came_back
  FROM firsts AS f
  JOIN delivered AS d ON d.customer_unique_id = f.customer_unique_id
  WHERE f.first_day >= DATE '2017-01-01'
    AND f.first_day < DATE '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY f.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE came_back = 1) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_pct
FROM people

CP1.explanation: customer_id changes with every order, so only customer_unique_id follows one person across orders; grouping by customer_id makes every buyer look new, and an address can be shared by several people.

CP5.explanation: Every month's return window ends on 31 August 2018, so the late months had fewer months to come back; a window of the same length per month is needed before calling anyone less loyal, and nothing here shows that sale buyers never return.
